condition

condition

historical_inference

they should harme us

source_internal_forecast
not continue very long

condition
neither Sun Moon were fixed

hardned English hearts against him

authorial_retrospective_event

authorial_retrospective_event

condition

intention meet Majesty

source_groups.label: Mars square Saturn threat versus partial Nottingham outcome

Souldiery quite destroy Army

source_internal_forecast
crossed at or near aspect

authorial_retrospective_event
eleventh of April Nottingham

authorial_self_qualification
